name: Censorship
overview: Scripture reveals that censorship, when rooted in godly conviction, involves rejecting and removing wickedness and falsehood, as seen in God's command to destroy the altars and names of false gods (Deuteronomy 12:3) and the commitment to avoid setting wicked things before the eyes (Psalms 101:3). However, ungodly censorship is condemned, exemplified by the Pharisees who shut the kingdom of heaven against men (Matthew 23:13), and those who hate the light to avoid their deeds being exposed (John 3:20). The Bible warns against suppressing truth through unrighteousness and deception (Romans 1:18; Titus 1:10), urging believers to uphold the truth without compromise.
